why: Backup post. Explain one watch feature in plain words (GMT, perpetual calendar, moonphase, flyback, power reserve, tourbillon, minute repeater, dive bezel...). One trusted source (named) for how it works. Never stop: if one feature has no library watches, pick another.

The cover is a watch photo, not a movement shot, and the caption question needs a small match to the CTA slide.
